job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed s81ph-dsfd_capt_x-501831f78-safe-tt (dsfd_capt_x, RTL 501831f78, snapshot of 2 drifted files): same RTL, outline 118.8x270.0, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:s81-ph (tiles)

benches.name: exact_cap_tiled
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_x_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_x_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { bash tools/s81_ph/capt_bench.sh {RUN}/bench t1 'mix mix11 mix12 mix13 trace err over range rreq' S81PH_CAP_SAFE
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 501831f78 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_capt_x_m5/src]

benches.cmd:
